Based on the search results, here's information about LG UltraGear OLED monitors in the UK for 2026:

## Current Pricing (GBP)

The UltraGear OLED GX7 (27GX790B) is priced at £899.98 and is the only model currently available to buy immediately.

The LG UltraGear 39GX950B has appeared on LG's UK website at £1599.98, available to pre-order with shipping ETA 17 June 2026.

## Key Specifications

The GX7 uses fourth-generation OLED with Primary RGB Tandem technology to reach 1500 nits of peak brightness, with a 0.02ms grey-to-grey response time. Its Dual-Mode panel switches between QHD 540Hz for competitive use and HD 720Hz for applications where frame rate takes full priority.

For the ultrawide models, the UltraGear evo GX9 (39GX950B) features a 39-inch 5K2K curved ultrawide OLED display with a 1500R curved design, while the GM9 has a 27-inch 5K (5120×2880) display with up to 1250 nits of peak brightness.
